rules.statement: A plaintiff seeking a declaration of title and possessory relief must establish their title to the entire disputed land, not just an undivided share.
rules.supporting_quote: "The action being one for declaration of title and possession, the burden was on the Plaintiff to establish his title to the land which was in dispute. The action cannot be decided only on answers to issues 3 and 4 which relate only to aspects of possession, as submitted by counsel for the Appellant."
